unresolvedDecisions: After five real exercises, decide whether review timing should remain manual or use a simple fixed interval.
After real data exists, decide whether localStorage remains sufficient or a larger browser store is justified.

next.reason: It is the only active dependency-ready task and proves the smallest complete learning flow before reflection, review, analytics, backend or AI features are considered.

ownerSummary.whatIsBeingBuilt: A private local JavaScript practice log that preserves the learner's own attempts and mistakes.
ownerSummary.whyThisTaskNow: The first risk is not review scheduling or AI quality; it is whether the learner will record and recover one real attempt without the product becoming another answer generator.
ownerSummary.whatNotToDo: Do not add AI hints, code execution, authentication, backend, sync, dashboards, streaks or review algorithms during JPL-001.
ownerSummary.whatComesAfter: JPL-002 may add mistake and lesson reflection only after the create-save-reload flow is verified and accepted.
